Free trial. I downloaded this app because it offered a free trial and wanted to see if it was worth paying for. After using it once, I wasn't impressed and decided it wasn't something I wanted to continue with. Unfortunately, that wasn't the end of the experience.
Ever since, the app has relentlessly pestered me to update my payment information. What's most frustrating is that there appears to be no way to permanently dismiss these notifications or stop the constant reminders unless you actually subscribe. It feels less like a free trial and more like a never-ending sales pitch.
A good app should respect a user's decision when they choose not to continue after trying the service. Instead, this one seems determined to nag users into paying. The lack of an option to disable these prompts creates a frustrating user experience and makes the app feel pushy rather than helpful.
If you're considering trying the free trial, be aware that deciding not to subscribe may not be enough to stop the constant payment-related notifications. Based on my experience, the annoyance of dealing with those reminders outweighed any value the app provided. I won't be using it again.
